scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a 3D model, into a photorealistic photograph with the same camera, composition and landforms: a small Hellenistic Greek port town on a harbour, terraced hill behind. Replace every placeholder with real rock, scrub, stone and tile; hill blobs become olives and cypresses. Keep every modelled building's shape, roof, doors and windows: whitewashed plaster walls on a low rubble base, terracotta roofs, earth streets. Winter overcast: soft flat light, no hard shadows. [image 2] is a reference board: copy its man, cart, mule and tablet exactly. A narrow unpaved road, one cart wide, climbs out of the town between the rocks toward us; on it the board's cart of lashed oil amphorae drawn by the board's mule, a carter in a plain tunic at its head, leaving the town. On the rocks in the right foreground, above the road, the man (short dark hair, neat dark beard, undyed chiton, dark brown cloak) holds the open wax tablet, watching the cart pass below. No other people. Nothing modern.
